design: Three repeats of five-fold participant CV; three-fold inner MAE selection for microbiome and combined ridge alpha 0.1,1,10,100,1000. Genus Hellinger transformation is sample-local; standardization fitted within folds. Horvath comparator is training-calibrated linear regression. No AgeAccel columns, GrimAge2 or clinical outcomes are used as age-prediction inputs.
primary: Paired mean absolute error reduction: calibrated Horvath minus combined; secondary microbiome minus combined.
uncertainty: 10,000 paired participant bootstrap resamples of participant losses averaged across repeats; conditional on fitted predictions.
status: Exploratory public pilot; no external cohort; prior clock-training overlap unverified; complete results reported regardless of sign.
